purpose: Compare static character languages that could replace the default stick figure before spending video-generation budget.

shared_contract.composition: one full-body character centered in a square 1:1 frame with generous clean margin
shared_contract.scene: neutral studio backdrop with a restrained ground shadow
constraints: no text, letters, logos or watermark

evidence_boundary: These images demonstrate static visual directions only.
They do not prove animation quality, action readability in motion, cross-shot identity consistency, model success rate or cost.
The stability labels are design hypotheses based on structural simplicity, not measured video benchmark results.

prompt_spec.texture: subtle paper fibers and layered edges
